positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Application Developer at the Biomedical Informatics Department Center of Precision Medicine at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. Duties includes:

- Further developing the ETL pipeline to integrate the electronic health records including wearable, survey data, and measurements from participating health care organizations for the All of Us program using Google Cloud Platform, in specific AppEngine, BigQuery, etc.
- Further developing data cleaning components after integrating the raw wearable, survey data, and measurement data to standardize physical measurement values and concepts used by different health care sites to ensure the data is usable by researchers.
- Developing API's to assist in validating participant data to ensure all participants are properly enrolled and consented in the All Of Us program before data is cleaned and given to researchers.
- Properly developing local integration and unit tests.
- Creating technical design documents for future features

positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
In my role as Scrum Master, I:
-Facilitated daily stand up meetings with the offshore technical team to capture scrum team progress
-Tracked and managed spring progress using Jira
-Coordinated sprint planning and retrospective sessions with the offshore development team to manage agile development efforts
-Provided weekly development progress reports (status slides) to the Project Manager
-Lead the design, build, and configuration of two new products into the Client's Intelligent Patient Platform to meet business process and application process
-Was accountable for sprint capacity and velocity definitions
-Coordinated across project and CMSO teams to support migrations across the Client's Salesforce environment
-Identified and communicated third party vendor dependencies/issues with the Project Manager
-Facilitated weekly stand up meetings with the third party vendor to capture API integration progress
-Supported SIT and UAT efforts by responding to any questions or raised defects and fixing high level defects

positions.title: Application Tech Support Practitioner
positions.description:
In my role as Application Support Practitioner I,
-Assisted with the de-duplication process to prepare business for the clients new system upgrade
-Created daily Technical Alerts which would inform the agents on the desk of any new announcements or process flows
-Took calls from business users who had various issues with the new system once it was upgraded
-Manned the daily Help Desk Chat to quickly respond to any live questions from the agents on the desk
-Audited cases to make sure the necessary information was included to better assist business users
-Assisted in 'white glove' treatment and account set up/clean up for business with over 200 clients

projects.title: The Colorization and Tagging of Grayscale Images
projects.description: During this project, we created a color and tagging recognition system with the use of Python programming language. We also created a graphical user interface in order to allow the user to tag and colorize an uploaded image. The testing and training images were nearly 1000 images of 7 different types of bears, collected from Google images. These images were processed by our Python code, which allowed them to go through pre-processing of re-sizing and gray scaling these images. From a trained Convolutional Neural Network, a model was trained to find patterns in those images to predict the type of bear in the image. After tagging the image, the user can choose to colorize the image. During the colorization process, the image will predict the colors needed for coloring the image based on the pre-trained knowledge fed through the neural network. Future works will be creating a neural network that will predict the colors needed to color a grayscale image and be able to color the image entirely.
